main.description: Append-only audit record emitted by open-otology-uhl-r whenever institution.matchQuery is invoked. PII-zero (ADR-2605181040): records the inputs that determined the routing (substrate class, locale, DFNB9 gate) and the count of returned candidates — never patient identifiers, never institution-specific scores. Operators consult this collection to audit decision-support usage; researchers consult it for aggregate substrate-class distribution.

localeCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 patient locale at query time.

dfnb9Confirmed.description: Whether V02 biallelic OTOF ACMG class 4-5 was confirmed (gates GENE_TX_OTOF per ADR-2605181060).

candidateCount.description: Number of institutions returned by V16 InstitutionMatcherActor (after topN trim).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 emit time at the AppView.
